name: OpenXBL
tagline: Self-serve Xbox Live profiles, presence, achievements, and friends API
description: OpenXBL provides third-party developers with REST access to Xbox Live profile, presence, achievements, friends, and related social data via the xbl.io platform. It is a community/self-serve wrapper around Xbox Live services rather than Microsoft's official Xbox API, aimed at apps that need player identity and gaming activity without building full Xbox partner integrations.

auth.details: API key via X-Authorization header (self-serve signup at xbl.io); some endpoints may also accept Authorization

pricing.free_tier_limits: 150 requests per hour indefinitely; no credit card required.

rate_limits: Free 150/hour; Small 500/hour; Medium 2,500/hour; Large 5,000/hour; Enterprise custom. Limits reset hourly; excess returns HTTP 429. Microsoft per-user/per-title FGRL also applies.
use_cases: look up Xbox profile by gamertag or XUID
check a player's current presence or online status
list achievements for a title or player
fetch friends list and social graph
get recent games or activity for a player
